criteria.description: Only accepted contacts appear in server mailbox; read cursors are account-scoped and monotonic.
Client uses shared summary SDK and falls back safely on older Social servers.
Windows and Android/Web live accounts show matching unread state and accurate read sync after interaction.
Migration 5 activates with accounts, contacts and prior messages intact.
Device opt-in and explicit capability negotiation never imply live registration before backend and distributor exist.
OS notifications, mobile resume and current chat/unread behavior work on target devices.
Scoped guest access and verified per-user principal prevent user spoofing and device impersonation.
Device API and WebSocket-ticket integration use LoopRD published routes, safe URLs and content-free wakes.
Actual LoopRD/ntfy and Windows/Android clients accept and validate sessions, device endpoint proof and recipient wakes.
LoopRD management role grants are explicitly declared and never expose password/token hashes.
Only verified trusted callers can broadcast admin events; recipient/role are always checked server-side.
Source release activates in LoopRD and an administrator can receive and dismiss/revoke a test event.

checks.description: Authenticated server mailbox, owner-only read cursor integration
assertions: Cross-device sessions share recipient read cursor.
Unaccepted contacts cannot read or advance cursors.
Schema migration only adds the new read table.

checks.description: SDK mailbox and client UX tests
assertions: Notification deduplication respects server read cursor.
Client uses only authenticated Social endpoint; old-server fallback persists.

checks.instructions: Sign in with one Tavi recipient account on Windows and Android or browser. Send a DM from another account. Confirm matching unread, then open it on one and verify the other clears after refresh; verify native chat window and notifications.

Back up production component database. Review/push generated looprd.yaml, deploy schema 5 and verify existing accounts, contacts, DMs and sessions survive. Test unauthorized DM read requests and confirm successful rollback planning.

checks.description: Local push preference/capability validation and foreground wakeup unit tests
assertions: Unexpected or missing backend capabilities do not enable background notifications.
Preference storage contains only opt-in state and is scoped to server+account.
Wake-up hints are bounded, content-free, deduplicated and require a signed-in client.
Foreground resume triggers a throttled authoritative server refresh.

checks.description: Windows and Android native OS notification and resume acceptance
checks.instructions: Import to existing looprd-social ZipRunner project, build Windows client and Android APK, sign in, test OS notification, suspend/resume Android and validate inbox refresh. Verify background status clearly says pending until LoopRD and UnifiedPush distributor integration exists; do not mark real push delivered.

checks.description: Verified principal, message recipient and rollback regressions
assertions: Guest scope cannot enroll devices or access private operations
Authenticated subject must match Social session
Failed durable event transaction rolls back message
Recipient wake uses only server-resolved principal ID

checks.description: Exact LoopRD push device API, verification, ticket and privacy checks
assertions: Authenticated bearer is sent only to same Social component
Device registration/verification/delete routes and payloads match LoopRD
Content-free wake schema rejects tokens and message bodies

checks.description: Real LoopRD, ntfy and client end-to-end acceptance
checks.instructions: Deploy compatible LoopRD runtime, enable push provider and install updated Tavi; verify guest signup, user login, push device challenge activation, accepted-friend DM wake, scoped denial and revocation. Confirm native closed-app Android push is not yet accepted.

checks.description: Ecosystem admin entitlement, service identity, fanout, revocation and rollback
assertions: Promote/revoke sources are explicit named operator actions.
Unprivileged sessions cannot self-promote.
Only private configured machine principals can invoke admin notification or role contracts.
Notification writes and recipient wakes occur in one SQL transaction.
Role revocation denies previously stored service-origin event access.

checks.description: Live LoopRD Data & actions and service contract smoke
checks.instructions: Push reviewed 0.3.22 source; reconcile LoopRD with management.data and service.contracts; back up DB and confirm schema6. Promote one test account in management panel, configure a mounted machine credential and calling-component dependency, publish one HTTPS-link notification, verify admin-only inbox and service-only authorization, revoke role, and check audit and removal of event access. Do not claim native closed-app Android delivery.
